title: morsel.json
description: Declares a single Morsel app within a repository.

name.description: Unique app identifier within the repo. Lowercase alphanumeric and hyphens only. If omitted, the repo itself is the app.

dockerfile.description: Path to the Dockerfile relative to the repository root. Build context is always the repo root.

private.description: If true, the app is reachable only within the cluster VPC. Applies to http type only.

tier.description: Quota tier name. Changing to a higher tier requires operator approval. Defaults to the platform default tier.

idle_after.description: Inactivity duration before the app hibernates. Applies to http type only. Go duration syntax: '1h', '30m', '24h'.

path.description: HTTP path for the readiness probe. Applies to http type only. Must start with /.

timeout.description: Maximum time to wait for a rollout before rolling back. Go duration syntax: '5m', '10m'.

schedule.description: Cron expression for the job schedule. Required when type is 'cronjob'. Five-field format: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week.

timeout.description: Maximum execution time for a single job run. Required when type is 'cronjob'. Go duration syntax: '30m', '1h'.

retries.description: Number of times to retry a failed job run. Applies to cronjob type only. Only use if the job is idempotent.

persistence.description: Declares platform-managed resources. Each resource is provisioned on first deploy and persists based on the permanent flag.

database.description: Provisions a dedicated Postgres database at database.morsel.internal.

permanent.description: If true, the database is retained when the app is deleted.

storage.description: Grants blob storage access at blob.morsel.internal.

permanent.description: If true, stored objects are retained when the app is deleted.

queues.description: Grants message queue access at queue.morsel.internal.

permanent.description: If true, queue data is retained when the app is deleted.
